facts.fact: CITC states that the National ID System project contributed, through the State budget, to establishing the Civil Status Information Center and building the birth, death, marriage, divorce and family registration databases; the page gives no date, so its published year is used.
facts.system: Civil Status Information Center birth and death databases

facts.fact: CITC states that it gives technical support to the main computers at the main centre in Abbasiya and manages the system and program library jointly with the technicians of the Civil Status Organization, whose national-number databases integrate the birth and death databases; the page gives no date, so its published year is used.
facts.system: Civil Status Information Center birth and death databases
